name: Nimitz class
note: US Navy nuclear-powered CATOBAR supercarrier (CVN-68 to CVN-77), two A4W reactors (effectively unlimited propulsion endurance, ~20 years between refuels). Air wing of around 64 aircraft (capacity ~90), primarily F/A-18E/F. Ship's company ~3,532; total complement with air wing ~5,700-6,000. Full-load displacement has grown past 100,000 tons on later hulls.

name: Gerald R. Ford class
note: US Navy nuclear-powered CATOBAR supercarrier replacing the Nimitz class; EMALS electromagnetic catapults, Advanced Arresting Gear, two A1B reactors (25%+ more power), reduced crew, and reduced radar signature. Dual Band Radar on CVN-78 / SPY-6 EASR from CVN-79. Full-load displacement and top speed are not in the retrieved excerpt.

name: Queen Elizabeth class
note: Royal Navy STOVL carrier (conventionally powered, integrated electric propulsion; built 'for but not with' catapults). Ski-jump flight deck operating the F-35B; Artisan Type 997 and S1850M radars. Air group 40 aircraft in peacetime (up to 72 in wartime; ~12-36 F-35B). Ship's company 679, ~1,600 with the air group. Range 10,000 nmi. Top speed not in the retrieved excerpt.

name: Liaoning / Shandong
note: PLAN Type 001 Liaoning, rebuilt from the ex-Soviet Kuznetsov-class hull Varyag; STOBAR ski-jump (no catapults), Type 346 S-band AESA radar, ~24 J-15 fighters plus helicopters. The near-sister Type 002 Shandong is a modified indigenous build with broadly similar figures. Displacement, air-wing size and speed are not in the retrieved excerpt.

name: Fujian
note: PLAN Type 003 Fujian, China's first indigenous CATOBAR carrier and the second in the world (after Gerald R. Ford) with electromagnetic catapults (MVDC integrated power). Conventionally powered. Air wing of J-15T, J-35 stealth fighters, KJ-600 AEW&C and Z-20 helicopters. Commissioned November 2025.

name: INS Vikrant
note: Indian Navy Vikrant-class (IAC-1), India's first indigenously built carrier; STOBAR ski-jump, MF-STAR AESA radar, two 32-cell Barak-8 VLS. Air wing of MiG-29K (Rafale M on order), Ka-31, MH-60R. Range 8,000 nmi. Commissioned 2022.

name: Charles de Gaulle
note: French Navy Charles de Gaulle (R91), France's only carrier and the only nuclear-powered CATOBAR carrier outside the US. Rafale M fighters and E-2C Hawkeye AEW aircraft; 32 Aster 15 SAM cells (4x8 Sylver) plus Mistral. Displacement, air-wing size and speed are not in the retrieved excerpt.
